title: Soft Body Physics
description: A rudimentary soft body physics engine.
info: Press left click on a vertex of the rectangle and move the mouse pointer to move it.

title: Physics Sketcher
info: Use the buttons to select an element and press left click to place it. You can then interact with its nodes using left click or set its label using right click.

title: Beige Balls
info: Press left click to spawn a ball or hold right click to spawn multiple.

title: Map Renderer
description: Renders the Europa Universalis IV map.
info: Use WASD to move and scroll to zoom.

title: Clock
description: Testing time with an unorthodox clock design.

title: Dungeon Generator
description: Generates dungeons with a random walk algorithm.
info: Press space to generate a new dungeon.

title: Solar System
description: A scaled down solar system to explore.
info: Use WASD to move, left click and right click to zoom in and out.

title: Raycasting
info: Left click and drag to create rectangles, right click to place circles and use up/down arrows to increase/decrease circle radius.

title: Gravity Simulator
info: Use up/down to adjust the particle mass, left/right to adjust particle size and WASD to set the particle force, then press left click to spawn the particle.

title: Voronoi
description: Generate a voronoi pattern from some points.
info: Left click to place a point or right click to randomly place points and then press space to generate the pattern. Press enter to clear the canvas.
